lines.en: They say ‘self-immolation’ is one of the most painful ways to die, and I had just experienced it.
It feels as though every neuron in my brain is lighting up at once.
[The exclusive skill, ‘Fourth Wall’, reduces mental pain.]
The pain gradually subsides.
[Fourth Wall] again?
Whenever this skill helps me through a crisis, I always feel strange.
‘Ways of Survival’ has clearly become reality, and I am living inside it.
Then······ what exactly is this ‘wall’ I feel every time?
No, enough pointless thoughts.
I had successfully obtained the ‘King of No Killing’ attribute, and I needed to get moving again.

King of No Killing, an attribute obtainable only by upholding the condition of not killing one's own kind (同族不殺) all the way to the end of the road. Despite its name, this attribute's benefit was actually closer to ‘immortality (不死)’ than ‘no killing’. Strictly conditional, of course······.
Anyway, I would soon return to my physical body.
More precisely, that was what I thought.
[Activation of the ‘King of No Killing’ benefit is delayed due to an exclusive skill conflict error.]
..Huh?
A skill conflict error?
[Death completely frees your consciousness from the constraints of your body.]
[Stage 3 of the exclusive skill, ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’, is forcibly activated.]
A wave of dizziness swept over me, accompanied by a startled feeling of ‘whoa, whoa’.
No, hold on. This wasn't the time for this!
「“Damn it. If it hadn't been for that bastard.”」
For an instant, vertigo washed over me, and my surroundings brightened.
And I was watching a certain ‘scene’.

「Gong Pildu, one of the Ten Evils, watched the people milling around farther in on the platform and stuck out his lower lip. What if he ran away, even now? He entertained the thought, but he knew better than anyone that he lacked the courage to act on it.
“Mmm······ Dokja hyung.”
Feeling a weight pressing gently against his knee, Gong Pildu looked down. Had the boy only just turned ten or so? A boy lay asleep with his head on Gong Pildu's thigh.
“How did I end up like this······?”
Gong Pildu frowned slightly as he looked down at the fair skin of the sleeping Lee Gilyoung.
For the first time in a while, old memories come flooding back.
A young child.
He, too, had certainly had a daughter around Lee Gilyoung's age.
He shakes his head and sighs.
―Pildu-ssi, let's stop now······.
―Dad. How long are you going to keep going on about land?
There had certainly been a time when he, too, was the head of a family.
Earning money to feed his family, buying land with that money, then getting into speculation, becoming a landlord through a stroke of luck, taking in tenants······.
He had finally become a ‘big hand’—a major investor—in Chungmuro, but it hadn't taken him long to learn that this ‘big hand’ was actually a hand incapable of protecting even one small family.
“It's surprisingly nice, isn't it? Getting along with people.”
He looks up and sees a beautiful woman with delicate features.
Yoo Sangah.
The woman who had become deputy representative of ‘Chungmuro’ two days earlier.
“Hurry up and take this brat away.”
“But you were smiling just a moment ago······.”
Gong Pildu's lips twitched in apparent displeasure.
With a little heave-ho, Yoo Sangah plopped down beside Gong Pildu.
“Ajusshi, how much ‘land’ did you own, anyway?”
“What?”
“When you think about it, everyone in the ‘Landlord Alliance’ owned land, but you were the only one who obtained the ‘Great Landowner’ attribute.”
“······Owning a lot of land isn't necessarily a good thing. It has to be good land. You're so naive.”
“Then what kind of land is good land?”
“Expensive land is good land.”
“What kind of land is expensive?”
“Land that lots of people want.”
“Was that the kind of land you owned, ajusshi?”
“Yes.”
Though it wasn't the land I wanted.
Gong Pildu met Yoo Sangah's gaze.
There is something oddly sharp about this woman's curiosity. On the surface, she is all smiles, but how to put it? As though she harbors some unfathomable unease.
Snap. Pop. Pop.
That was when a sound like very fine threads snapping came from far away.
Yoo Sangah's expression hardened, and Lee Gilyoung, who had been sleeping with his head on Gong Pildu's knee, snapped his eyes open.
Tremble.
The antennae of the cockroach clinging to the back of Lee Gilyoung's hand were trembling.
Rrrrrumble.
Line 4, the tunnel toward Hoehyeon.
Something was approaching them.
Yoo Sangah sprang to her feet, and Gong Pildu deployed his skill.
[The character ‘Gong Pildu’ activates the skill ‘Armed Zone Lv.8’!]
Whiiiiir―
Gong Pildu bit his lip.
How to put it? An intuition only rich landowners have, perhaps. There is such a thing.
This was.
“Hey! Everyone, gather round!”
The feeling he had when someone was trying to take his land.
Ratatatatat!
As Gong Pildu's turrets opened fire in unison, things collapsed in the darkness, spraying blood. They were ground rats.
“We're under attack! Everyone, take positions around Gong Pildu-ssi! Use the formation we practiced this morning!”
At Yoo Sangah's shout, the people scattered across the platform came running.
“Group A, near the front turrets! Group B, where the turret fire can't reach! Group C, guard Gong Pildu-ssi!”
Moving in perfect coordination, the people formed the ranks they had practiced beforehand.
The charging ground rats fell helplessly before their swift response. Their movements were far smoother than when they had fought through ‘Emergency Defense’.
As dozens of ground rats fell to the ground, the same thought occurred to the members of the Chungmuro group.
This is easy. Just as we thought, we can manage if everyone works together.
Then a voice came from beyond the tunnel.
“So, [Hamelin's Flute] isn't enough after all?”
“Yoo Joonghyuk took this place. You think mere grade 9 subterranean species could stand a chance?”
A group of men and women emerged from the darkness.
Four men and one woman.
Gong Pildu's expression hardened.
He doesn't know why. But he can be certain of one thing.
These bastards are different from the ones he has faced so far.
“Damn it······ Hurry up and get that samurai girl!”
“I'm already here, you know?”
He sensed a chilling presence, and there was Lee Jihye, having come down with a vivid blue longsword drawn.
“And don't call me a samurai. Unless you want divine punishment.”
Despite her grumbling reply, Gong Pildu felt himself calm a little. Lee Jihye was that great an asset in battle.
Even so, Gong Pildu was uneasy.
Because he was uneasy, he growled first, like a frightened beast.
“Who are you? Where did you come from!”
“So it was true. The Maritime Admiral and the Armed Fortress Master on the same team.”
What came back instead of an answer was a murmur, almost a remark to oneself.
Gong Pildu asked.
“What bullshit are you talking about? Pull your line back, now. Otherwise, I'll shoot every last one of you dead!”
But the five continued talking among themselves without so much as looking at Gong Pildu.
“Who's been sent out on the ‘dragon hunt’?”
“The fifth, sixth, eighth, and ninth. Plus one fairly useful guy who isn't an <Apostle>.”
“Apart from the ones outside Seoul, that leaves the five of us.”
“The five of us are enough. Let's wipe them out quickly.”
The first to step forward was a potbellied man in his thirties.
A man with the number ‘7’ written on his shoulder. With thick eyebrows and a face glistening with oil, he smacked his lips as he eyed Lee Jihye's pale legs.
“I'll take the ‘Maritime Admiral’. Without the sea, that bitch is nothing special.”
“What did you say, you bastard?”
Lee Jihye let out a shrill shout and charged first. Realizing there was no avoiding it now, Gong Pildu poured magic power into his turrets.
“Damn it, just fucking die, all of you!”
Ratatatatat!
The man with ‘4’ written on his cape gave a nasty grin.
“One of the Ten Evils is still one of the Ten Evils. If we'd come a little later, we'd have been the ones getting wiped out.”
“Third and fourth. You two take Gong Pildu. Don't let your guard down for a second, and take out the turrets one by one, starting at the edges.”
The man with ‘3’ written on his forehead nodded.
“Well······ all right. For one of the Ten Evils, it should take the two of us.”
“And second, you take care of the rest.”
At that, the woman with ‘2’ written on her cheek frowned.
She held a small flute in her hand.
“Why do I get the small fry?”
“You're the best person for the job.”
“Then what are you going to do?”
The man with ‘1’ written on his dark cape opened his mouth.
“I will seize the ‘flag holder’.”」
My immersion briefly weakened, and my awareness returned.
Now I understand everything.
Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint.
I had experienced something similar inside the ‘ichthyosaur's’ stomach.
Back then, I had seen Yoo Joonghyuk.
Still, this was surprising.
I had thought those <Apostle> bastards would have made plenty of preparations, but this much?
The items they had brought alone showed how thorough they had been.
A [Magic Bullet Disintegration Shield] that could defend against Gong Pildu's attacks, and even [Hamelin's Flute] to command the ground rats.
They truly intended to conquer Chungmuro, get their hands on Yoo Joonghyuk, and swallow this world whole.
But it wouldn't be that easy.
「“Wh-what the hell! Was the Maritime Admiral this strong right from the start? Hey, isn't something wrong?”
The seventh apostle was the first to start complaining.

Lee Jihye's sharp swordsmanship was gradually driving the seventh apostle back. It couldn't have been otherwise. The current Lee Jihye was far stronger than the Lee Jihye who appeared in the original ‘third round’.
“Damn it, were Gong Pildu's turrets this tough?”
The third and fourth were in trouble as well.
The second apostle, playing [Hamelin's Flute], was also struggling against Yoo Sangah's [Thread Binding] and Lee Gilyoung's ‘Mjolnir’s Thunder’.
In the end, the ‘first apostle’ stepped forward.
He frowned, then took something from inside his clothes and lit it.
Then he threw it toward the Chungmuro group.
KABOOOOOM―!」
With a deafening roar, an explosion engulfed the Chungmuro platform.
At that moment, even I was taken aback.
······That goddamn bastard?
[Mass Destruction Magic Bomb]
A weapon of mass destruction that could scarcely inflict serious damage on higher monster species, but was devastatingly powerful against humans.
It was a weapon that could only be made with certain materials found in Gangseo and Gangnam, together with several items available for purchase in the [Dokkaebi Bag].
That bastard was the ‘king’ of the <Apostles>.
The ‘purple flag’ planted behind his back proved it.
The Chungmuro platform revealed through the pale dust.
My chest begins to tighten.
If they had that weapon, the battle had now turned against our side.
Where the dust settled, I could see the fallen members of the Chungmuro group.
People coughing up blood after being struck by sharp fragments.
Yoo Sangah and Lee Gilyoung lay on the ground. Even Gong Pildu, who possessed [Barrier], was covered in wounds, apparently unable to escape the surprise attack entirely.
「“Whew, now that's more like it. Right?”
The ‘seventh apostle’ lifted Lee Jihye by the hair, her school uniform torn. Having taken the explosion at the front, she had suffered the worst damage of the group.
“If you're a supporting character, act like one, huh?”
“You son of a bitch······ Guh!”
Lee Jihye screamed as a fist struck her stomach.
“I can have this bitch, right?”
“What would you do with her? We don't even have time.”

“What do you think? I didn't read the later parts, so I don't know, but isn't a character like this destined to get fucked senseless by the protagonist and then pitifully discarded anyway? If that's how it's going to be, I might as well······.”」
Lee Jihye's small body swayed in the air like a doll.
Her trembling lips.
She was looking at me.
A sudden surge of rage swept through my mind.
It wasn't like me.
Lee Jihye was certainly a ‘character’.
[The exclusive skill, ‘Fourth Wall’, vibrates faintly.]
But just because she was a ‘character’.
[Some functions of ‘Fourth Wall’ are restricted due to excessive immersion.]
Had I become too immersed?
For an instant, my vision shook, and a dizzying wave of nausea hit me.
[Proficiency in ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’ rises dramatically due to excessive immersion.]
[Changing the viewpoint to first person.]
My surroundings spun through a full turn, and my consciousness stretched like a rubber band.
And when I opened my eyes the next moment.
I really was in Chungmuro.
Lee Jihye's wavering eyes were looking at me.
She wasn't the only one.
At that moment, everyone on the platform was looking at me.
My field of vision moves slowly.
I walked toward Lee Jihye.
More precisely, my body was moving independently of my will.
One step, then another.
Slowly, but steadily.
The distance between her and me was shrinking.
The seventh apostle frowned and asked.
“What are you······?”
An uncomfortable feeling, like wearing clothes that didn't fit.
An eye level subtly different from usual, and five senses (五感) that felt alien.
At that moment, ‘I’ realized who I was.
A hollow laugh escapes me.
I hate this. I really hate this.
Lee Jihye's lips moved slightly.
My hand grasping the sword hilt as though performing an act repeated millions upon millions of times.
The sensation of my fingers wrapped around the grip was unfamiliar.
A sword draw (拔刀) so natural, even beautiful.
I shuddered at the exquisite sensation, unlike anything I had ever felt before.
The soundless blade moved.
And no one could see it.
Only,
Something swept past.
Something was severed.
And something fell to the ground.
Some were shocked, while others gaped blankly.
The ‘seventh apostle’, who had been holding Lee Jihye, slowly sank to the ground. Blood gushed in spurts from his now-bare neck.
My hand moved and caught Lee Jihye's small, falling body.
I gently lower the gasping Lee Jihye onto the platform.
When I straightened, the apostles were staring at me with wide eyes.
The third apostle was the first to speak.
“Who······ the hell are you?”
Ridiculous.
Could there be a stupider question?
My mouth moved slowly.
As though I had been this man all along.
“I am Yoo Joonghyuk.”
The coldest, loneliest voice in the world.
At last, the prince sleeping in the forest had awakened from his deep slumber.
“And all of you will die here.”
Chungmuro would be safe now.
I felt my consciousness leave Yoo Joonghyuk's body and slowly return to my own.
[Stage 3 of the exclusive skill, ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’, is deactivated.]
[The skill conflict error has been resolved.]
[The delayed ‘King of No Killing’ benefit activates again.]
[Your physical body is resurrected from death.]
[Regeneration of the body begins.]

Like an accidental drop of paint spreading, my vision slowly clears. The light, shadow, and saturation around me were indistinct. Bones and capillaries, the digestive and respiratory systems, entire eyeballs regenerating. Senses that had yet to find their proper places tangled together in confusion.
Anyway, with Yoo Joonghyuk taking action, I could stop worrying about Chungmuro.
No matter how strong the <Apostles> were, surely they couldn't defeat Yoo Joonghyuk, who had become even stronger than in the original third round.
Still······ that had been a truly unusual experience.
To experience being Yoo Joonghyuk in the first person.
If possible, I never wanted to do it again.
[The exclusive skill, ‘Fourth Wall’, offsets the mental shock caused by death.]
[The reward for using stage 3 of Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint is being prepared.]
······A reward for using it?
I could see Jung Heewon shouting in the distance. Lee Hyunsung's horrified face as he held her back. And Jung Minseob and Lee Sungkook, staring this way in shock.
Fortunately, all my companions are safe.
I hadn't been too late.
“Dokja-ssi!”
Jung Heewon shouted, apparently forgetting that she was supposed to conceal my name.
GRAAAAAH!
Though there probably wasn't any need to conceal it now, anyway.
Huuuuup.
Air filled my newly formed lungs.
Nearby, the lesser dragon was still continuing its merciless slaughter.
“As expected of Yoo Joonghyuk-nim!”
“Did he use Recovery?”
Of all those Prophets, only a tiny handful remained alive.
Of course, I didn't possess anything like ‘Recovery’.
Healing serious wounds and returning from the dead were entirely different things.
[The ‘King of No Killing’ benefit has been completed.]
[100 karma points have been consumed.]
[All waste products are expelled from your body, improving its performance.]
[Constitution and Magic Power levels each rise by 1.]
A resurrection bonus on top of everything.
This was why ‘King of No Killing’ was so overpowered.
In all of ‘Ways of Survival’, the only person to obtain this attribute had been Selena Kim of the United States.
[Current karma points : 0/100]
[Replenish your points for the next resurrection.]
[You gain 1 karma point each time you save the life of one of your own kind.]
The benefit of ‘King of No Killing’ was ‘resurrection’.
Of course, resurrection wasn't unconditional. It required something called ‘karma points’.
Fortunately, I was fortunate enough to start with 100 points supplied for the first resurrection.
GRAAAAAH!
[The grade 5 fire dragon species, Lesser Dragon Igneel, uses ‘Flames of Destruction’.]
I couldn't die again as soon as I came back to life.
With my points at 0, I couldn't use the resurrection benefit for a while.
As it happened, there was a platform marked with the number ‘2’ nearby.
The others had already taken their places on their respective platforms.
“Hyunsung-ssi, go over there! We'll take the platform next to it!”
Following Jung Heewon's quick decision, Lee Hyunsung came scrambling toward me.
Sweat streaming off him in the intense heat, Lee Hyunsung spoke.
“Dokja-ssi, are you all right?”
“As you can see.”
“······For a moment, I thought my eyes were playing tricks on me.”
Even if he asked how such a thing was possible, there was no time to explain in detail.
[Activating Absolute Shield.]
The Flames of Destruction split before my eyes with a roaring rush.
I asked Lee Hyunsung, who was looking at me as though he had just met Jesus himself.
“Hyunsung-ssi, do you have anything I could put on? A rain poncho or······.”
“I may be a soldier, but I don't carry anything like that······ Ah.”
Belatedly realizing the situation, Lee Hyunsung looked me over.
Coming back to life was good, but there was one thing I hadn't considered.
The [External Reinforced Suit], which had at least served as protective gear, had melted, and most of the miscellaneous items I had picked up were lost as well.
In other words, I was currently naked.
“······No, that won't be necessary.”
Lee Hyunsung's hand, which had been discreetly moving toward his waistband, returned to its original position.
No matter how selfless a person was, there had to be a limit.
In any case, what I needed right now wasn't clothing, but my dropped items.
Even ‘Flames of Destruction’ couldn't melt [Star Relics] or a scenario's key items.
Sure enough, [Unbreakable Faith] was rolling around at the lesser dragon's feet, and the scenario item, [Brown Flag], lay nearby as well.
Of all places, they had to fall there··· At least it wasn't somewhere anyone else could easily pick them up.
As soon as the shield deactivated, my companions began running over from a distance.
Jung Heewon led the way as they ran toward me.
“Dokja-ssi!”
As Jung Heewon ran toward me, her expression slowly froze.
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ gazes steadily at your black flame dragon.]
The moment I discreetly turned my back to escape her gaze, I felt something gently cover my shoulders and back.
“I didn't look, so don't worry. Is this really the time to worry about that crap?”
My body flinched reflexively at the words ‘that crap’.
Something like a rain poncho was covering my body.
On closer inspection, it was a straw mat.
[Samyeongdang's Straw Mat].
Come to think of it, Jung Heewon had this.
“Thank you, Jung Heewon-ssi.”
Right now, I was grateful even for this.
[The constellation ‘Bald General of Justice’ feels a little hurt.]
“Let's move.”
GRAAAAAH!
Lesser Dragon Igneel's fire-breathing phase began.
Once again, we circled counterclockwise to evade its attacks.
Jung Heewon and Lee Hyunsung ran ahead of me.
They apparently did it out of consideration for the ‘black flame dragon’ dangling between my legs as I ran.
The straw mat was more ragged than I had expected and couldn't cover my entire front.
Obliviously running beside me, Jung Minseob asked.
“What should we do now, Representative-nim? All the other <Apostles> are dead······.”
As Jung Minseob said, there were no remaining <Apostles> in sight.

As proof, Blue Ice Pills remained where they had died, rolling around like sarira relics. The item took a long time to digest, and its material resisted heat, which apparently kept it from melting in the flames.
Whoooosh!
The lesser dragon's foreleg flying in, cutting through the air.
“Aaaaaagh!”
Two Prophets following our group were crushed like lumps of meat.
I immediately crossed the center of the platform and retrieved the flag and [Unbreakable Faith].
[You have recovered the ‘Brown Flag’.]
[You can use the flag's protection again.]
Looking around, I see that only our group remains now.
While I considered one approach after another, the time for the platforms to activate was already drawing near.
[The numbered platforms activate!]
“Gather round!”
Luckily, a platform displaying the number ‘5’ activated.
The problem was that only one platform had activated this time.
The intermediate dokkaebi's voice came from the air.
[Hehe, you're still holding out well. But will your luck keep holding?]
Next time, the number displayed above this platform might be 3 or 4.
If that happened, someone in our group would certainly die.
Worse still, if a 6 came up······.
[The grade 5 fire dragon species, Lesser Dragon Igneel, uses ‘Flames of Destruction’.]
[Activating Absolute Shield.]
We had barely bought another 10 seconds.
I had to treat this as our last chance.
“Whew······ that damn bastard. Dokja-ssi, what do we do?”
Lee Hyunsung and Jung Heewon looked exhausted as well. Naturally. They had already spent ten or so minutes running through heat so intense they could barely breathe.
“I think we'll have to fight.”
“Didn't you say we couldn't kill it?”
“With those, it isn't impossible.”
I pointed at the ‘Blue Ice Pills’ rolling around on the ground.
As it happened, there were exactly five Blue Ice Pills, the same number as our group.
If we swallowed those items the <Apostles> had prepared, dealing damage to the lesser dragon wouldn't be impossible.
The problem was whether we could kill it before its next ‘attack on everyone’ began.
[Absolute Shield deactivates.]
“Run! And first, each of you pick up one of those things on the ground!”
At my words, my companions darted out.
[You have invested 4100 coins in Magic Power.]
[Magic Power Lv.16 -> Magic Power Lv.25]
[Your soul resonates with the world!]
To deal a burst of damage in the time we had left, I needed to raise Magic Power rather than Strength.
I gulped down the Blue Ice Pill I had picked up.
[The cold attribute has been temporarily unlocked.]
[40% additional cold attribute damage is applied.]
Now all that remained was to deal damage.
How would I do it?
There was a limit to simply charging in.
Lee Hyunsung had [Great Mountain Smash], but lacked Agility. Jung Heewon had excellent Agility, but lacked the power for a heavy blow.
It would be good if we could attack its vulnerable spots.
Could I perhaps see something like that with [Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint]?
Ah, come to think of it······.
[The exclusive skill, ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’, is already in use.]
[The reward for stage 3 of the exclusive skill, ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’, is available.]
It had mentioned a ‘reward for using it’ earlier.
[You have experienced ‘First-Person Protagonist’s Viewpoint’.]
[You may inherit one of the skills of the protagonist you became immersed in.]
For a moment, I was so stunned that I failed to see the lesser dragon's foreleg flying toward me. The nimble Jung Heewon shoved me aside, and the spot where I had been standing caved in.
KABOOM!
“What are you spacing out for!”
Jung Heewon's rebuke came at me, but I had no time to answer.
I could inherit one of the skills of the protagonist I had become immersed in.
That meant I could acquire one of that bastard ‘Yoo Joonghyuk's’ skills.
[Displaying the available skill choices.]
Oh-ho, I even got to choose?
Now that I had taken a Blue Ice Pill, what if I could acquire one of Yoo Joonghyuk's skills?
Even something like Strong Self-Defense or Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship would be enough······!
[Choose the skill you wish to acquire.]
1.Cold Resistance
2.Flame Resistance
3.Lie Detection
······Damn it. Of course.
There was no way things would work out that easily.
Of the choices offered, ‘Lie Detection’ was the one I liked best, but it was useless to me right now.
The most useful skill in this situation was option 2, ‘Flame Resistance’······.
GROOOOOOAR―!
The roaring lesser dragon was scattering flames. Once it finished that action, the ‘Flames of Destruction’ phase would soon begin.
Think.
I'm a ‘reader’.
The answer is in what I've read.
[Your attribute's effect improves your memory of what you have already read!]
Pages turn rapidly in my mind.
How to defeat the lesser dragon.
Bits of information from the 12th, 14th, and 17th rounds.
And what I had available to me now.
“Dokja-ssi, hurry······!”
I slowly close my eyes and open them.
And.
“Acquire Cold Resistance.”
I made my decision.
[You can now use the skill ‘Cold Resistance’.]
I turned toward my companions and shouted.
“Jung Heewon-ssi, Lee Hyunsung-ssi! You haven't taken your Blue Ice Pills yet, right? Give them all to me.”
“What?”
“Lee Sungkook, Jung Minseob! You too!”
Jung Minseob, who had been about to put a Blue Ice Pill in his mouth, stuck out his lower lip.
“Hurry!”
“Ah, yes!”
The four Blue Ice Pills were quickly gathered.
Dodging the raining flames, I tipped all of them into my mouth at once.
I am certain.
This is the best choice.
[You have taken Blue Ice Pills.]
[Attribute stacking increases the Blue Ice Pills' attribute damage!]
[200% additional cold attribute damage is applied.]
[A chill that threatens to freeze your heart envelops your entire body.]
Normally, this was something one should never do.
Despite their name, which sounded like a medicinal elixir, Blue Ice Pills were actually a type of poison.
Even one pill caused chills as though one were naked in the dead of winter. Naturally, taking five would cause one to freeze to death on the spot.
That is, that was what should have happened under normal circumstances.
[The exclusive skill, ‘Cold Resistance Lv.5’, protects you.]
Apparently, I had inherited some of Yoo Joonghyuk's proficiency, because the skill was level 5 right from the start.
“Everyone, get behind me!”
I shouted to my companions and grasped my sword hilt.
Was it because of my memory of becoming Yoo Joonghyuk earlier?
The sensation of holding the sword had subtly changed.
[‘Blade of Faith’ activates!]
Wheeeee!
[The special option of ‘Unbreakable Faith’ activates.]
[The ether attribute changes to ‘darkness’.]
[The Blue Ice Pills' effect adds ‘cold’ to the ether attribute.]
The Ether Blade took on a dark blue glow. Cold and darkness stacked together.
SHAAAAA!
The dark blue Ether Blade began cutting through the flames. Unleashing all my strength, I charged toward the lesser dragon.
From here on, it was an all-out battle.
[You have activated the stigma ‘Song of the Sword’.]
[A randomly selected verse left by the Duke of Loyalty and Warfare imbues your sword.]
Song of the Sword, whose buff varied depending on the verse that appeared.
Please, just don't give me a strange verse.
「Deep in the night, a divine figure (神人) appeared in my dream and said, “Do this, and you shall win a great victory; do that, and you shall be defeated.”」

I wondered what kind of verse this was, but suddenly, different parts of the ‘lesser dragon's’ body began appearing in different colors. Most of its body looked green, but certain areas stood out in red.
[The constellation ‘Maritime War God’ cheers you on in battle.]
Only then did I understand the Duke of Loyalty and Warfare's intention.
I see.
Those were its weak points.
I ran along the burning path and swung my sword at the root of the lesser dragon's wing.
The first was pale red.
GRAAAAAAAH!
I slip beneath the thrashing creature's wing joint and sever the Achilles tendon of its hind leg.
The second was deep red.
KRAAAAAAAH!
As I leapt to avoid its tail, its foreleg flew toward me as though it had been waiting.
THWACK!
[The ‘Brown Flag’ effect activates a protective barrier.]
It couldn't block the flames, but it could withstand a few ordinary attacks.
I lunged in close to the roaring creature and drove my sword straight into it.
Shunk!
Its chest was a red almost the color of blood.
KRAAAAAAAGH!
The lesser dragon began its desperate struggle.
The protective barrier created by the Brown Flag shattered in an instant, and flames began gathering in its mouth.
[The grade 5 fire dragon species, Lesser-Igneel, prepares ‘Flames of Destruction’.]
At last, it entered its phase for attacking everyone.
There was no shield now.
Wheeeeeee!
